ui_strings_regulatory_relevant.text: Device catalogue and batch/lot traceability — forward and backward, from real records.
Medical Devices — Your device catalogue and the batches made from it — with a forward and backward trace built from records of what actually happened.
<manifest.title> v<version>. <manifest.description> Not provided in this build: <notProvided joined>

Medical Device Manufacturing — Product master and batch/lot traceability for device manufacturing. Records what a manufacturer knows about its articles and batches; makes no regulatory or certification claim.

Quality Center (NCR, CAPA, inspection records) — not implemented in this stage. | Document control lifecycle — not implemented in this stage. | Lot merge — deliberately unsupported; see the traceability documentation for why. | Electronic signatures and records validation (21 CFR Part 11) — not implemented, not claimed. | Any regulatory certification. This software is not validated software.
The device catalogue. Classification here is your own configuration — NeuroPause makes no regulatory or certification claim about any product.
Nothing recorded. What is required differs by device, market and year, so NeuroPause imposes no schema and treats empty as a normal state.
A product code and a name are all that is required. Everything else can be filled in later — guessed classification on a record a recall reads is worse than none.
Recording a UDI or a risk class here stores the value. It does not make anything compliant, and NeuroPause is not validated software.
placeholder: {"riskClass":"IIb","market":"EU"}
placeholders: TR-1001 | 4.5mm Cortical Screw | 4.5 × 40 mm | Ø4.5 mm, L40 mm | Single sterile blister
The device catalogue: identity, classification, material, sterility, packaging and traceability configuration. Records what the manufacturer knows; makes no regulatory claim.
The sterility state you record for this article. NeuroPause cannot verify it and does not claim to.
Serial tracking requires batch/lot tracking — a serial that cannot be attributed to a batch cannot be recalled by batch.
Holding a UDI here records the identifier. It does not make anything UDI-compliant.
Classification here is catalogue configuration. NeuroPause makes no regulatory or certification claim about any product.
Batches with an explicit lifecycle, conserved quantities and forward/backward traceability. Created and changed only in the Batch/Lot Center.
Many devices have no expiry. Empty means "no expiry recorded" — never "unknown risk".

This lot is recalled. Its forward trace lists everywhere the material went. | A lot is the unit a recall is executed in. Its quantity is derived from immutable counters, so it cannot be edited into disagreeing with what was consumed or shipped.
Batch / Lot Center — Batches, their lifecycle, and the quantities that must stay reconciled with what has been consumed, split and shipped.
Lifecycle — Only the transitions the state machine allows are offered.
Shipping draws material, so it is refused from a quarantined, blocked or recalled batch. Leave the quantity empty to ship everything remaining.
Only products with Batch / Lot Tracked turned on can carry a batch — a lot against an untracked product could never be recalled by batch.
Many devices have no expiry at all. Leaving Expires empty is normal and never means "unknown risk".
Recalled — trace forward to see everywhere this went | The expiry date has passed, but the lot has not been marked expired | Blocked — material cannot be drawn | Quarantined — release before use
Your role does not include the medical device scope this needs. An administrator can grant it.

Merging lots is not supported. A merged lot cannot say which inputs produced which unit, so a defect in one input would force the recall of material that was never at risk. To combine material, record a manufacturing order that consumes each lot and produces one output lot — the output lot then traces back to every input.

Quality status: Not yet configured. The Quality Center (inspections, non-conformances, CAPA) is not part of this build, so no quality record exists for any lot. | Documents: Not yet configured. Document control is not part of this build; no batch record or certificate is attached to any lot.
Follow real recorded movement between lots, manufacturing orders, warehouses, shipments and customers.

…nothing has been recorded yet… this is not a statement that the material went nowhere. | …no recorded movement… | Every step is a record of something that happened — nothing here is inferred from a name that looks similar.
